text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing intense itching and red bumps on your thigh and other areas; to determine the cause, have you recently traveled to any wooded or grassy areas where you might have encountered ticks?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. speaker: Doctor
